name: dftracer_pipeline_run
description: Create, recall and list dftracer pipeline runs (run_id <app_name>/<YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS>, workspace with session.json, active run pointer .current_run) and validate the result. Load when a stage needs a run_id, 'No runs found for app', 'No active run pointer for app', a run_id that does not match its app, or a run that vanished after the workspaces root changed (DFTRACER_WORKSPACES).

history.why: converted from dftracer-agents register_run_tools (pipeline_create_run, pipeline_get_run_id, pipeline_list_runs, moved unchanged) and the run-ID rules of the dftracer-pipeline skill; new validator dftracer_pipeline_run_check
